name: Scorpion-class Intercept Shuttle
description: The Scorpion-class Intercept Shuttle was a model of shuttle used by the Mandalorians of the Hidden Chain during the Third Galactic War. A spacecrafts of this class possessed with light armaments and features variable wing configurations for swift, maneuverable flight in-atmosphere. It carries a 12-person armored squad, their gear, a pilot, and a navigator. Mandalorians can deploy via a ladder in vertical mode, exiting rapidly with jetpacks.
